name: builder-restore-selection
title: Restore selected module works straight after excluding it

issue.title: Module builder clears the module selection after excluding it, so Restore needs a reselect
issue.expected: The excluded module stays selected, so Restore selected module works at once.
issue.actual: The selection is cleared; Restore warns 'Select an included module in the Modules tab'.
issue.dt_test: tests/desktop/test_assessment_ui.py: select a module in the builder's module list, exclude it, assert the list keeps it selected, and assert 'Restore selected module' restores it without reselecting.
suspected: dt/assessment_ui.py: AssessmentBuilder.refresh rebuilds lists without restoring the current row
